categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies files exclusively in src/wallet/ to remove global state access in ExternalSignerScriptPubKeyMan.
categories.rationale: Removes direct global access to gArgs and Params() inside ExternalSignerScriptPubKeyMan by passing configuration parameters down from CWallet. While beneficial for architectural hygiene and decoupling, it is an internal refactoring without direct impact on fund safety or user-facing behavior.
